gitCommit.subject: Epic C PR3 — session lifecycle: pause + session-undo (#250)
gitCommit.body:
Epic C PR3 — session lifecycle: pause + session-undo (#250)

* plan: Epic C PR3 (session lifecycle: pause + session-undo) task-by-task

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq

* feat(session): findByIdIncludingDeleted + restore repo/controller (Epic C PR3)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq

* feat(api): POST /sessions/[id]/restore with IDOR re-auth (Epic C PR3)

Restore (undo "set aside") re-activates a soft-deleted session. The active
GET/PATCH/DELETE handlers 404 on soft-deleted rows, so restore resolves the
session INCLUDING soft-deleted via getSessionIncludingDeletedOrNull.

Authz mirrors authorizeSession's order — existence -> collection gate -> curator
gate -> action. The curator gate (curatorId !== userId -> 403) closes the IDOR
(purses-t9l): a different curator who IS a member of the shared collection passes
the collection gate, so only the curator check stops them restoring someone
else's set-aside session.

Tests: un-mocked route->controller->repo->pg integration covering happy path,
the co-member IDOR (403 + stays soft-deleted), stranger, absent id (404), and no
auth (401). Registers the route in the filesystem-exhaustive stranger-403/404
backstop (purses-o03).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq

* feat(sort): "Take a break" pause + calm landing + Resume + New-Session gating (Epic C PR3)

Render AppLayout's declared-but-unused actions slot (breadcrumbs left, actions
right). Add TakeABreakControl (PATCH status:paused -> calm landing) to the triage
and compare chrome, and ResumeControl (PATCH status:active -> sort screen). On the
sort landing, treat active|paused as the current session, show a calm "your sort is
safe" card with Resume when paused, and gate New Session / Create Session whenever a
current session exists (purses-4bhh: a 2nd open session 500s on sessions_active_unique).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq

* feat(session): confirmation + persistent Undo after setting a session aside (Epic C PR3)

Restructure the collection-landing set-aside affordance into ActiveSessionPanel,
a client island mounted UNCONDITIONALLY by the page (not inside
`{activeSession && …}`). It holds the `undo` state itself, so the persistent
`role=status` "Set aside — you can bring it back · Undo" notice survives the
router.refresh() that flips activeSession to null and unmounts the card — the
PR2 lesson (TriageUndoProvider). Undo POSTs the Task-2 restore route.

Keeps the two-step reveal→confirm gate, in-flight guard, focus-to-cancel, and
gentle error path. Folds AbandonSessionButton's logic into the island and
removes it; coverage ported to ActiveSessionPanel.test.tsx (no auto-dismiss
timer, aria-hidden middot, undo-survives-null, double-tap guards, error paths).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq

* test(e2e): session pause + set-aside undo across viewports (Epic C PR3)

Pause flow (session-pause.spec.ts): seed a journey, open triage, tap the
chrome "Take a break" (await the real PATCH status:paused), assert it lands on
the /sort landing — never a triage URL — showing the calm paused card ("Your
sort is paused" / "Your sort is safe"), assert "New Session" is gated (button
AND link absent, purses-4bhh), tap Resume (await PATCH status:active), assert
it returns to the numbered sort session and the landing now reflects active.

Set-aside undo flow (session-undo.spec.ts): seed an active session surfaced on
the collection page, two-step "Set aside" (reveal → confirm, await the real
DELETE), assert the persistent role=status "Undo" notice survives the
active-session card disappearing, tap Undo (await POST /restore), assert the
active-session card returns and the notice clears.

Both await real 2xx side-effects (no sleeps), robust role/name locators, run in
all 3 viewport projects. Adds a "sort-paused" screenshot surface to capture.ts
(seed a collection+session, flip to paused via SessionRepository.update),
light + dark.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq

* fix(session): 409 (not 500) on existing-session conflict + calm paused badge + chrome alignment (Epic C PR3 whole-branch review)

A: sessions_active_unique 23505 (active/paused/completed/soft-deleted slot) now
throws typed CurrentSessionExistsError -> errorResponse 409, never a raw 500.
Caught in SessionRepository.create (real safety net; route bypasses the service)
and mapped in the sessions route + http-errors; SessionService pre-check throws
the same typed error. New un-mocked DB test pins 409 for active and set-aside
slots with no orphan row.

B: paused Badge re-mapped off the amber safety palette to the cool-blue benign
accent-cornflower + ink (DESIGN.md 'brand never speaks Danger'; matches the
'Not yet' treatment). Contrast gate already proves AA both themes; Badge test
locks it.

C: AppLayout actions slot wrapped in shrink-0 + mb-6 so a long breadcrumb no
longer squeezes/offsets the action; action-less pages unchanged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq

* chore(graphify): refresh graph for session lifecycle (Epic C PR3)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq

* docs: sync API/ARCHITECTURE for session restore + pause + 409 net (Epic C PR3)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq

* docs(design): benign paused status badge uses cool-blue, never amber (Epic C PR3)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq

* feat(api): POST /sessions/[id]/restore with IDOR re-auth (Epic C PR3)

Restore (undo "set aside") re-activates a soft-deleted session. The active
GET/PATCH/DELETE handlers 404 on soft-deleted rows, so restore resolves the
session INCLUDING soft-deleted via getSessionIncludingDeletedOrNull.

Authz mirrors authorizeSession's order — existence -> collection gate -> curator
gate -> action. The curator gate (curatorId !== userId -> 403) closes the IDOR
(purses-t9l): a different curator who IS a member of the shared collection passes
the collection gate, so only the curator check stops them restoring someone
else's set-aside session.

Tests: un-mocked route->controller->repo->pg integration covering happy path,
the co-member IDOR (403 + stays soft-deleted), stranger, absent id (404), and no
auth (401). Registers the route in the filesystem-exhaustive stranger-403/404
backstop (purses-o03).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq

* feat(sort): "Take a break" pause + calm landing + Resume + New-Session gating (Epic C PR3)

Render AppLayout's declared-but-unused actions slot (breadcrumbs left, actions
right). Add TakeABreakControl (PATCH status:paused -> calm landing) to the triage
and compare chrome, and ResumeControl (PATCH status:active -> sort screen). On the
sort landing, treat active|paused as the current session, show a calm "your sort is
safe" card with Resume when paused, and gate New Session / Create Session whenever a
current session exists (purses-4bhh: a 2nd open session 500s on sessions_active_unique).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq

* feat(session): confirmation + persistent Undo after setting a session aside (Epic C PR3)

Restructure the collection-landing set-aside affordance into ActiveSessionPanel,
a client island mounted UNCONDITIONALLY by the page (not inside
`{activeSession && …}`). It holds the `undo` state itself, so the persistent
`role=status` "Set aside — you can bring it back · Undo" notice survives the
router.refresh() that flips activeSession to null and unmounts the card — the
PR2 lesson (TriageUndoProvider). Undo POSTs the Task-2 restore route.

Keeps the two-step reveal→confirm gate, in-flight guard, focus-to-cancel, and
gentle error path. Folds AbandonSessionButton's logic into the island and
removes it; coverage ported to ActiveSessionPanel.test.tsx (no auto-dismiss
timer, aria-hidden middot, undo-survives-null, double-tap guards, error paths).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq

* test(e2e): session pause + set-aside undo across viewports (Epic C PR3)

Pause flow (session-pause.spec.ts): seed a journey, open triage, tap the
chrome "Take a break" (await the real PATCH status:paused), assert it lands on
the /sort landing — never a triage URL — showing the calm paused card ("Your
sort is paused" / "Your sort is safe"), assert "New Session" is gated (button
AND link absent, purses-4bhh), tap Resume (await PATCH status:active), assert
it returns to the numbered sort session and the landing now reflects active.

Set-aside undo flow (session-undo.spec.ts): seed an active session surfaced on
the collection page, two-step "Set aside" (reveal → confirm, await the real
DELETE), assert the persistent role=status "Undo" notice survives the
active-session card disappearing, tap Undo (await POST /restore), assert the
active-session card returns and the notice clears.

Both await real 2xx side-effects (no sleeps), robust role/name locators, run in
all 3 viewport projects. Adds a "sort-paused" screenshot surface to capture.ts
(seed a collection+session, flip to paused via SessionRepository.update),
light + dark.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Pbw6ZGrY8VvxyvbAEDpKjq

* fix(session): 409 (not 500) on existing-session conflict + calm paused badge + chrome alignment (Epic C PR3 whole-branch review)

A: sessions_active_unique 23505 (active/paused/completed/soft-deleted slot) now
throws typed CurrentSessionExistsError -> errorResponse 409, never a raw 500.
Caught in SessionRepository.create (real safety net; route bypasses the service)
and mapped in the sessions route + http-errors; SessionService pre-check throws
the same typed error. New un-mocked DB test pins 409 for active and set-aside
slots with no orphan row.

B: paused Badge re-mapped off the amber safety palette to the cool-blue benign
accent-cornflower + ink (DESIGN.md 'brand never speaks Danger'; matches the
'Not yet' treatment). Contrast gate already proves AA both themes; Badge test
locks it.

C: AppLayout actions slot wrapped in shrink-0 + mb-6 so a long breadcrumb no
longer squeezes/offsets the action; action-less pages unchanged.
